searchText: Still quite unclear how that increases blob count or how that makes the worst case better As I understand it the key limitation for blobs currently is for solo stakers being able to publish a locally produced block and its blobs in time. If they’re late publishing the blobs the block with be orphaned. If the blobs are available to other nodes via the EL mempool already the solo staker, having used their own local mempool to create the block, will very likely not be impacted by their upload bandwidth limits slowing down blob publication because the blobs are already widely available. They would still be tho Would still be what? They may still be slow publishing the blobs but it wouldn’t matter because they are already available via the mempool. Yeah what I am saying is that those blobs are not neccasairly in everyone blob pool It is just very loosely scaling and tbf gains are not even that high from the optimization ELs not yet supporting blobs retrieval from the mempool can return empty array as a default implementation of `getBlobsV1` in any case I think it is late now to include it by pectra I'm ok with indicating Fusaka somehow indicate fusaka then ok, done. I wasn't sure the best way to phrase it, open to suggestions in general, since there's no "Osaka" page to yet create an update list of changes, or really mention of Osaka in any way alright, changed that PR as-is back to Pectra nonoptional. If we want to go for Fusaka-nonoptional, that can wait longer, so less concerned re that PR. But, the TOCTOU thing is really problematic to the point where if at all possible I do not want Nimbus to depend on capabilities-probing I just think it is a bit late to voice this But we will get it done asap I mean, I'd be happy with this even personally CLs already have to handle empty-response case the point really is to have the existence of the endpoint itself not be in question I agree it's late for a "full" implementation (including testing, etc) Its late for anything

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: Still quite unclear how that increases blob count or how that makes the worst case better

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content:
As I understand it the key limitation for blobs currently is for solo stakers being able to publish a locally produced block and its blobs in time. If they’re late publishing the blobs the block with be orphaned. 
If the blobs are available to other nodes via the EL mempool already the solo staker, having used their own local mempool to create the block, will very likely not be impacted by their upload bandwidth limits slowing down blob publication because the blobs are already widely available.
